coder_notes: Multi-tumour Phase 1 basket; glioblastoma (IDH-wildtype grade 4) is explicitly eligible only in Part 1 and Part 4a (CNS tumours), both ABBV-706 monotherapy. regimen coded monotherapy for the GBM-eligible parts; Parts 3a/3b (SCLC/NEC only) combine ABBV-706 with budigalimab (investigational, so ABBV-706 is experimental_combination there) or platinum (coded soc_backbone as standard SCLC/NEC chemotherapy; could be read as experimental_combination). SEZ6 expression is analysed retrospectively, not an entry requirement; 'potential SEZ6 expression' describes tumour types. IDH and 1p/19q appear only as diagnostic definitions of eligible CNS tumour types (IDH-mutant gliomas also eligible), so not listed as selection biomarkers. PK is serum/plasma only.
